subtitle: Manage your workspace and preferences
appearanceHint: Choose how CAD/CAM FUN looks on your device.
generalHint: Display units, language, precision and drawing preferences.
manufacturingHint: Set the default controller for generated machining programs.
saved: Preferences saved automatically on this device.
resetHint: Restore the default workspace preferences. Projects and library items are not affected.
languageHint: English is the available language in this release.
precisionHint: Controls display precision and G-code decimal places.
unitsHint: Geometry is stored in millimetres; display and G-code units follow this preference.
unsupportedPost: LinuxCNC and SmoothWB are not available in the current machining core. Select GRBL, Fanuc or Generic G-code.
shortcutsHint: Keyboard commands available in the desktop workspace.
